# Phone simulator results

Generated by `cargo run -p proxim-sim --example phone_report`; checked by `cargo test -p proxim-sim --test phone_sim`. Every number below comes from running the real engine (`proxim_decide::decide`) inside each simulated partner app, one location fix per second. How to read it: `docs/phone-simulator.md`.

## Partner apps and what they accept

| App | What it is | Accepts | Blocks | Prefers (weight) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CareWell | health and wellbeing | health, fitness, food.healthy | alcohol, gambling | health (2000), fitness (1200) |
| RoadMate | navigation and driving | everything not blocked | alcohol, gambling | auto (2000), food.fast_food (1500), travel (1300) |
| FitStride | running and fitness tracking | fitness, food.healthy, retail.sportswear, health.wellness | - | fitness (2000), food.healthy (1500), retail.sportswear (1500) |
| ShopSmart | shopping deals | retail, food, beauty, entertainment | alcohol, gambling | retail (2000), food (1200) |
| CityGo | city guide and transit | everything not blocked | gambling | entertainment (1800), travel (1500), food.cafe (1200), alcohol (1100) |
| KidsQuest | a children's game (child-directed) | nothing (child-directed: the engine is off) | - | - |
